findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
750.1110d - Toilets and urinal in restrooms were observed to be soiled (mold rings beginning to form/splash). Clean toilets and urinal as needed and maintain clean.

Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.citation_text:
750.830 - (R) Chlorine test strips were not found during the inspection. Person that met inspector was unsure as to where the test strips may be stored. Make sure test strips are available and used for checking the concentrations of bleach solutions during events.
A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.
50ppm = bleach solution concentration for manual ware washing at 3 part sink
100ppm = bleach solution concentration for spray bottles, buckets for wiping general surfaces, and all clean in place food contact surfaces (i.e. griddles, etc.)

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The spout of the coffee maker above the grounds basket was soiled with buildup. Clean and sanitize food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - Dust accumulation was observed inside the Lazy Susan cabinet. Clean inside cabinets as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Approved source
findings.citation_text: 750.100 - Home canned banana peppers were observed in the door of the fridge. The banana peppers were removed from the facility by the person who came to meet the inspector. Only foods from approved sources may be used at the facility. Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with all laws relating to food and food labeling. The use of home prepared or home canned foods is strictly prohibited.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.citation_text: 750.140 - A thermometer was not present in the fridge. Provide a thermometer. All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.citation_text:
750.830 - Chlorine test strips were not found during the inspection. Person that met inspector was unsure as to where the test strips may be stored. Make sure test strips are available and used for checking the concentrations of bleach solutions during events. If a bleach solution is too weak it is not properly sanitizing surfaces, and if a bleach solution is too strong then it is toxic. A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.
50ppm = bleach solution concentration for manual ware washing at 3 part sink
100ppm = bleach solution concentration for spray bottles, buckets for wiping general surfaces, and all clean in place food contact surfaces (i.e. griddles, etc.)

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled: A) spout of coffee maker above grounds basket (buildup) & B) inside microwave (dried food splash). Clean and sanitize all food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) inside cabinets, especially in the lazy Susan (dust buildup); B) under the microwave; C) general surfaces inside the freezer; D) general surfaces inside the fridge, especially the lower storage area and on the door; & E) bottom inside oven and broiler pan. Clean non-food contact surfaces as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.
